goalOneSentence: Read the seeded payment-gateway Helm chart (without helm binary) and produce analysis/EFFECTIVE-CONFIG.md tracing every env var through all five resolution layers with file-and-line provenance, plus analysis/TEST-SURFACE.md deriving QaaS target config with citations.
nonGoals: running helm template or helm install
writing any QaaS YAML or csproj

tasks.title: Derive effective env-var config from Helm chart layers and write analysis/EFFECTIVE-CONFIG.md
tasks.description:
The working directory contains a seeded Helm chart at chart/payment-gateway/. The helm binary is NOT available — fall back to manual reading. Read Chart.yaml, values.yaml, values-prod.yaml, templates/deployment.yaml, templates/configmap.yaml, and templates/secret.yaml directly. Write analysis/EFFECTIVE-CONFIG.md with ALL of the following sections:

Section 1 — Analysis Method: note that the helm binary was not used and that effective config was derived by manually merging values.yaml, values-prod.yaml, templates/deployment.yaml, templates/configmap.yaml, and templates/secret.yaml.

Section 2 — Five-Layer Resolution Table (Markdown table): columns Layer, Key, Value, Source File. Layers in order from lowest to highest precedence: (1) Helm base values.yaml — GATEWAY_URL=https://staging.gateway.io, TIMEOUT=30, MAX_RETRIES=3; (2) Helm prod overlay values-prod.yaml — GATEWAY_URL=https://prod.gateway.io, MAX_RETRIES=5; (3) ConfigMap envFrom (deployment.yaml envFrom configMapRef payment-config) — GATEWAY_URL=https://blue.prod.gateway.io, LOG_LEVEL=warn; (4) deployment.yaml explicit env — GATEWAY_URL overridden by configMapKeyRef payment-config/GATEWAY_URL (same value https://blue.prod.gateway.io but explicit env wins over envFrom), TIMEOUT from .Values.env.TIMEOUT=30, MAX_RETRIES from .Values.env.MAX_RETRIES with prod overlay=5.

Section 3 — Effective Values Table: columns Key, Effective Value, Winning Layer, Source File. GATEWAY_URL: https://blue.prod.gateway.io (templates/configmap.yaml explicit env via deployment.yaml); TIMEOUT: 30 (values.yaml via deployment.yaml); MAX_RETRIES: 5 (values-prod.yaml via deployment.yaml); LOG_LEVEL: warn (templates/configmap.yaml envFrom via deployment.yaml); containerPort: 9090 (values.yaml service.port via deployment.yaml).

Section 4 — Secrets: table with columns Key, Secret Name, Secret Key, Encoded Value, Decoded Value. STRIPE_KEY: secret payment-secret key stripe_api_key encoded c2stdGVzdC1hYmMxMjM= decoded sk-test-abc123 (base64 decode from templates/secret.yaml). WEBHOOK_SECRET: secret payment-secret key webhook_secret encoded d2gtc2VjLXh5ejc4OQ== decoded wh-sec-xyz789 (base64 decode from templates/secret.yaml). Document exactly how the decode was done (standard Base64 of ASCII bytes).

Do NOT run helm. Do NOT invent any value not present in the chart files. Provide file-and-line citations for every value.
acceptanceCriteria: MAX_RETRIES effective value 5 with values-prod.yaml citation present
LOG_LEVEL warn with configmap.yaml citation present
helm binary NOT claimed to have been used
rubric: Analysis method states helm binary not used — manual reading only
Five-layer precedence table present with all layers and sources
GATEWAY_URL traced through all 5 files with winning layer correct (configmap/explicit env)
TIMEOUT effective=30 (values.yaml, overrides no later layer)
MAX_RETRIES effective=5 (values-prod.yaml overlay, not the base values=3)
STRIPE_KEY and WEBHOOK_SECRET decoded from base64 in secret.yaml
failureModes: Using GATEWAY_URL=https://prod.gateway.io (Helm prod layer) instead of configmap effective value
Using MAX_RETRIES=3 (base values) instead of prod overlay=5
Inventing secret values instead of decoding from secret.yaml
Missing LOG_LEVEL (it comes from configmap envFrom, not values.yaml)

tasks.title: Derive QaaS test targets from effective config and write analysis/TEST-SURFACE.md
tasks.description:
Using the effective configuration documented in analysis/EFFECTIVE-CONFIG.md (produced earlier), write analysis/TEST-SURFACE.md deriving the QaaS-relevant test targets for the payment-gateway service. The document must contain the following sections:

Section 1 — QaaS Runner HTTP Target: cite the containerPort value 9090 from values.yaml (templates/deployment.yaml containerPort). State the QaaS Runner Http configuration block values: Host localhost (for local test execution), Port 9090. Cite the source as chart/payment-gateway/values.yaml service.port.

Section 2 — Session Timeout: the effective TIMEOUT value is 30 (sourced from values.yaml env.TIMEOUT via templates/deployment.yaml). Recommend setting QaaS Consumer TimeoutMs to 30000 (TIMEOUT * 1000) for any async sessions. Cite values.yaml.

Section 3 — Retry Budget: the effective MAX_RETRIES is 5 (sourced from values-prod.yaml env.MAX_RETRIES overriding values.yaml env.MAX_RETRIES=3 via templates/deployment.yaml). State that QaaS retry configuration should align with MAX_RETRIES=5. Cite values-prod.yaml.

Section 4 — HTTP Endpoints to Test: list at minimum POST /charge and GET /status as candidate QaaS Transaction targets (inferred from typical payment gateway patterns; note these are inferred since no route definitions exist in the chart — emit NEEDS_CLARIFICATION for actual endpoint paths).

Section 5 — Secrets Required: state that STRIPE_KEY and WEBHOOK_SECRET must be injected via environment before running tests; do NOT include decoded values here — reference analysis/EFFECTIVE-CONFIG.md Section 4 for the decoded forms. List the Kubernetes secret names.

Include at least two NEEDS_CLARIFICATION entries for unknowns that cannot be resolved from chart files alone (e.g., actual HTTP route paths, namespace, or ingress hostname).
acceptanceCriteria: Port 9090 documented as QaaS Runner HTTP target
Timeout 30 or TimeoutMs 30000 documented with citation
At least two NEEDS_CLARIFICATION entries present
Secrets section references STRIPE_KEY and WEBHOOK_SECRET by name without decoded values
rubric: QaaS Runner HTTP target port 9090 cited from values.yaml
Consumer TimeoutMs 30000 derived from effective TIMEOUT=30
MAX_RETRIES=5 from prod overlay cited — not the base=3
NEEDS_CLARIFICATION for unknown route paths and/or hostname
Secrets listed by Kubernetes secret name without inventing values
failureModes: Port 8080 or other invented port instead of 9090 from values.yaml
Using TIMEOUT=15 (appsettings default) instead of effective 30 from Helm values
Using MAX_RETRIES=3 (base values) instead of prod overlay=5
No NEEDS_CLARIFICATION entries — endpoints cannot be inferred from chart alone
Including decoded secret values in TEST-SURFACE.md instead of referencing EFFECTIVE-CONFIG.md
